zh.hero.alt: TerraForge 界面：贡嘎山一带的三维地形上覆盖着一个带角点手柄的矩形下载选区，左侧是框选、区域、搜索、光照、任务、配置的工具栏
zh.legend.cap.breaks: 等高线默认分层设色断点 · 逐档可改
zh.legend.cap.shot: 贡嘎山选区 · v0.3.4 实拍
zh.pipes.h2: 从一个选区，长出四种产物
zh.pipes.p: 同一块区域、同一套任务调度、同一份缓存。选完范围之后，剩下的差别只是你要什么格式。
zh.pipe.tiles.title: 框选下载，拼成带地理配准的 GeoTIFF
zh.pipe.tiles.body: 从 Google Maps 取瓦片，边下边镜像到产物目录。要瓦片目录、要拼接好的 GeoTIFF、要单文件 MBTiles，勾选框自己组合。
zh.pipe.tiles.spec.style.dd: 标准 m · 卫星 s · 卫星+标注 y · 道路 h · 地形 t
zh.pipe.tiles.spec.output.dd: 瓦片目录 · GeoTIFF（按 zoom 一层一张）· MBTiles（建任务时勾选或事后导出，不删原瓦片）
zh.pipe.tiles.spec.cache.dd: 按「样式 + 坐标」键控，跨任务共享 —— 换个任务重下同一片区，已有的瓦片不会再走一次网络
zh.pipe.tiles.alt: 下载数据对话框：显示选区四至、预计 8,537 块瓦片，可选瓦片 / GeoTIFF / MBTiles 输出与缩放级别 10–15
zh.pipe.tiles.caption: 建任务时先算清要下多少块
zh.pipe.dem.title: 1°×1° 分幅高程，默认源不用注册账号
zh.pipe.dem.body: 按你框的范围自动算出需要哪些分幅并逐个取回。默认走 Copernicus 的公开 S3 桶，开箱就能下；需要 ASTER 的话再去配 Earthdata。
zh.pipe.dem.spec.default.dd: Copernicus GLO-30（30 m，公开 S3 桶，免认证）
zh.pipe.dem.spec.optional.dd: ASTER GDEM v3 ASTGTM.003（30 m，需 NASA Earthdata 账号，在配置页填）
zh.pipe.dem.spec.aoi.dd: 地图框选，或导入 GeoJSON / KML / KMZ / Shapefile，支持多部件与孔洞
zh.pipe.dem.spec.antimeridian.dd: 越过 180° 的区域自动拆成两段处理
zh.pipe.dem.alt: 任务中心：总任务、已完成、失败数与累计下载量统计，下方是带类型标签和区域四至的任务列表，以及历史区域地图
zh.pipe.dem.caption: 任务中心 · 历史区域直接叠在地图上
zh.pipe.terrain.title: 切成 Cesium quantized-mesh，自带全球底座
zh.pipe.terrain.body: 把下载好的 DEM 或本地上传的 GeoTIFF 切成地形瓦片。包里随附一份全球基础地形，切片成果会植入它的输出目录 —— 相机拉远时不会掉进空洞。
zh.pipe.terrain.spec.base.dd: 随包 167 MB 全球基础地形（GEBCO 2024 Grid 派生，含海底地形、全球无洞），首次运行自动解压
zh.pipe.terrain.spec.cascade.dd: 你的高精度切片盖在底座上，缩小时自动接回全球
zh.pipe.terrain.spec.input.dd: 已下载的 DEM 任务，或本地上传的 GeoTIFF；无切片时也能按需渲染晕渲图预览
zh.pipe.terrain.alt: 喜马拉雅山脊的三维地形渲染：低角度视图，雪线以上的山体起伏与远处地平线清晰可见
zh.pipe.terrain.caption: 喜马拉雅山脊 · 开启地形光照
zh.pipe.contour.title: 渲染成标准 XYZ 瓦片，谁都能加载
zh.pipe.contour.body: 产物就是普通的 XYZ 瓦片目录，Leaflet、OpenLayers、CesiumJS 拿去直接用，不需要装 TerraForge 才能看。
zh.pipe.contour.spec.output.dd: 标准 XYZ 瓦片，Leaflet / OpenLayers / CesiumJS 直接加载
zh.pipe.contour.spec.style.dd: 等高距、首曲线与计曲线配色、分层设色断点、地形晕渲，逐项可调并支持预览
zh.pipe.contour.spec.source.dd: 上传 .tif（可多选），或复用已完成的 DEM 任务 —— 源文件零拷贝，删等高线任务不动原 DEM
zh.pipe.contour.alt: 天山一带的等高线瓦片渲染成果：分层设色的高程色带配合褐色等高线，叠在卫星影像底图上
zh.pipe.contour.caption: 天山选区 · 等高距 50 m · 分层设色 + 晕渲
zh.eng.eyebrow: 为什么不是又一个批量下载器
zh.eng.h2: 大任务真正的难处不在下载，在出问题之后
zh.eng.p: 几万块瓦片跑一夜，第二天你需要知道的是：到底成了没有、缺了什么、能不能接着跑。这四件事是 TerraForge 花力气最多的地方。
zh.eng.claim.progress.p: WebSocket 推送下载速度、剩余时间，以及分 zoom 的拼接与复制阶段。进度条不会停在 100% 让你猜后面还在干什么。
zh.eng.claim.missing.p: 瓦片结果分五类记账：成功、本来无数据、可重试失败、永久失败、缓存写入失败。只有「本来就没数据」才自动完成；出现真失败会停在待决策等你拍板，而接受了缺口的成果永久带缺块标记。
zh.eng.claim.resume.p: 断点续传、跨任务共享缓存、边下边复制、.part 临时文件加 rename 原子落盘。暂停、恢复、重试都不会重下已经拿到的瓦片。
zh.eng.claim.offline.p: 没有任何遥测、埋点或使用统计。前端第三方库全部本地 vendor，运行期不碰 CDN。除了你自己配置的图源、高程源与代理，它不连接任何服务器。
zh.eng.alt: 配置面板：主题与强调色、默认保存路径、并发下载数、请求超时、代理服务器与瓦片服务器列表等分组设置
zh.eng.caption: 配置 · 并发与超时 / 代理自动检测 / 缓存 / GDAL 参数 / Earthdata 账号
zh.dl.p: 三个平台的预编译包，解压就能跑，目标机器不需要 Python，也不需要单独装 GDAL。
zh.notes.1: Windows 双击 terraforge.exe，macOS / Linux 跑 ./terraforge，然后浏览器打开 http://localhost:5000。程序另会监听 5001 出瓦片，防火墙不放行也能用。
zh.notes.2: 没有安装包，也没有自动更新。不做 MSI / DMG / DEB，换版本就是重新下一个包。
zh.notes.3: 每个包都含 167 MB 的全球基础地形分卷，所以体积偏大。Release 页面附 SHA-256 清单，可校验你手上这份是不是原版。
zh.notes.4: Intel Mac 不支持 —— macOS 包只有 Apple Silicon (arm64) 一种。
zh.notes.5: 移动位置时整个 terraforge/ 目录一起搬。只挪可执行文件会报 Corrupt bundle: missing GDAL/PROJ data directories。
zh.notes.6: macOS 首次运行前，在解压出来的目录里执行 xattr -cr . 清掉隔离属性。
zh.notes.7: 程序监听 0.0.0.0:5000 且没有任何登录或鉴权机制，其 API 能读写本机磁盘路径并删除目录。只在可信的本机或局域网里用，别直接暴露到公网。

en.meta.title: TerraForge — Tiles, elevation, 3D terrain and contours: four pipelines, one interface
en.meta.desc: TerraForge is an open-source GIS data acquisition and processing tool: draw a box over an area to download map tiles and Copernicus elevation data, slice it into Cesium quantized-mesh 3D terrain, and render standard XYZ contour tiles. Unzip and run on Windows / macOS / Linux, no Python environment required.
en.meta.keywords: TerraForge,GIS,map tile download,DEM,elevation data,Cesium,quantized-mesh,3D terrain tiling,contour lines,GeoTIFF,MBTiles,Copernicus GLO-30
en.meta.og.title: TerraForge — Tiles, elevation, 3D terrain and contours: four pipelines, one interface
en.meta.og.desc: Draw a box over an area, download map tiles and Copernicus elevation data, slice it into Cesium 3D terrain and contour tiles. Unzip and run on Windows / macOS / Linux, no Python environment required.

en.lang.label: Language
en.hero.h1: Draw a box on the map,<br class="br-lg">turn it into data you can use.
en.hero.lede: Tiles, elevation, 3D terrain, contours — four pipelines packed into a single interface. Draw an area, watch the progress live, resume after an interruption; the outputs go straight into your GIS workflow.
en.hero.meta: MIT · Windows / macOS (Apple Silicon) / Linux · unzip and run, no Python
en.hero.alt: TerraForge interface: a rectangular download selection with corner handles laid over the 3D terrain around Mount Gongga, with a toolbar on the left for box selection, area, search, lighting, tasks and settings
en.legend.cap.breaks: Default contour hypsometric tint breaks · every step editable
en.legend.cap.shot: Mount Gongga selection · captured in v0.3.4
en.pipes.h2: One selection grows four kinds of output
en.pipes.p: The same area, the same task scheduling, the same cache. Once the extent is chosen, the only difference left is which format you want.
en.pipe.tiles.title: Draw a box, download, mosaic into a georeferenced GeoTIFF
en.pipe.tiles.body: Fetches tiles from Google Maps and mirrors them into the output directory as they download. A tile directory, a mosaicked GeoTIFF, a single-file MBTiles — combine them yourself with the checkboxes.
en.pipe.tiles.spec.output.dd: Tile directory · GeoTIFF (one file per zoom level) · MBTiles (ticked when the task is created, or exported afterwards; the original tiles are not deleted)
en.pipe.tiles.spec.cache.dd: Keyed by "style + coordinates" and shared across tasks — re-download the same area in another task and the tiles you already have never hit the network again
en.pipe.tiles.alt: Download data dialog: shows the bounds of the selection and an estimate of 8,537 tiles, with options for tile / GeoTIFF / MBTiles output and zoom levels 10–15
en.pipe.tiles.caption: The tile count is worked out before the task is created
en.pipe.dem.title: 1°×1° elevation tiles; the default source needs no account
en.pipe.dem.body: Works out which tiles your selection needs and fetches them one by one. It goes to the public Copernicus S3 bucket by default, so downloads work out of the box; configure Earthdata only if you need ASTER.
en.pipe.dem.spec.default.dd: Copernicus GLO-30 (30 m, public S3 bucket, no authentication)
en.pipe.dem.spec.optional.dd: ASTER GDEM v3 ASTGTM.003 (30 m, requires a NASA Earthdata account, entered on the settings page)
en.pipe.dem.spec.aoi.dd: Draw a box on the map, or import GeoJSON / KML / KMZ / Shapefile; multi-part geometries and holes are supported
en.pipe.dem.spec.antimeridian.dd: Areas crossing 180° are automatically split into two parts
en.pipe.dem.alt: Task center: totals for tasks, completed, failures and cumulative download volume, with a task list below carrying type labels and area bounds, plus a map of past areas
en.pipe.dem.caption: Task center · past areas laid straight onto the map
en.pipe.terrain.title: Sliced into Cesium quantized-mesh, global base included
en.pipe.terrain.body: Slices a downloaded DEM or a locally uploaded GeoTIFF into terrain tiles. A global base terrain ships inside the package, and tiling results are implanted into its output directory — pull the camera back and you will not fall into a hole.
en.pipe.terrain.spec.base.dd: A 167 MB global base terrain ships with the package (derived from the GEBCO 2024 Grid, includes bathymetry, hole-free worldwide) and is extracted automatically on first run
en.pipe.terrain.spec.cascade.dd: Your high-resolution tiles sit on top of the base layer and fall back to the global one as you zoom out
en.pipe.terrain.spec.input.dd: A downloaded DEM task, or a locally uploaded GeoTIFF; with no tiling it can still render a hillshade preview on demand
en.pipe.terrain.alt: 3D terrain rendering of a Himalayan ridge: a low-angle view in which the relief above the snow line and the distant horizon are clearly visible
en.pipe.terrain.caption: Himalayan ridge · terrain lighting enabled
en.pipe.contour.title: Rendered as standard XYZ tiles that anything can load
en.pipe.contour.body: The output is an ordinary XYZ tile directory. Leaflet, OpenLayers and CesiumJS can use it directly — TerraForge does not have to be installed to view it.
en.pipe.contour.spec.output.dd: Standard XYZ tiles, loaded directly by Leaflet / OpenLayers / CesiumJS
en.pipe.contour.spec.style.dd: Contour interval, intermediate and index contour colors, hypsometric tint breaks and terrain hillshading are each adjustable, with preview
en.pipe.contour.spec.source.dd: Upload .tif files (multiple allowed), or reuse a completed DEM task — the source files are not copied, and deleting the contour task leaves the original DEM alone
en.pipe.contour.alt: Contour tiles rendered for the Tianshan area: a hypsometric elevation ramp together with brown contour lines, laid over a satellite imagery basemap
en.pipe.contour.caption: Tianshan selection · 50 m contour interval · hypsometric tint + hillshade
en.eng.eyebrow: Why this is not yet another bulk downloader
en.eng.h2: With a big job the hard part is not the download — it is what happens after something breaks
en.eng.p: Tens of thousands of tiles run overnight; what you need to know the next day is whether it actually succeeded, what is missing, and whether it can carry on. These four things are where TerraForge spends the most effort.
en.eng.claim.progress.p: WebSocket pushes the download speed, the time remaining, and the per-zoom mosaicking and copying stages. The progress bar does not stop at 100% and leave you guessing what is still going on.
en.eng.claim.missing.p: Tile results are accounted for in five categories: success, no data at the source, retryable failure, permanent failure, and cache write failure. Only "no data at the source" completes automatically; a real failure stops in a pending-decision state and waits for your call, and a result whose gaps you accepted is permanently marked as having missing tiles.
en.eng.claim.resume.h3: It picks up where it stopped
en.eng.claim.resume.p: Resumable downloads, a cache shared across tasks, copying while downloading, and atomic writes via .part temporary files plus rename. Pausing, resuming and retrying never re-download tiles you already have.
en.eng.claim.offline.p: No telemetry, tracking points or usage statistics of any kind. All third-party front-end libraries are vendored locally, and no CDN is touched at runtime. Apart from the map sources, elevation sources and proxies you configure yourself, it connects to no server.
en.eng.alt: Settings panel: grouped settings for theme and accent color, default save path, download concurrency, request timeout, proxy server and the tile server list
en.eng.caption: Settings · concurrency and timeout / proxy auto-detection / cache / GDAL parameters / Earthdata account
en.dl.p: Prebuilt packages for three platforms. Unzip and run — the target machine needs neither Python nor a separate GDAL installation.
en.notes.1: On Windows double-click terraforge.exe; on macOS / Linux run ./terraforge, then open http://localhost:5000 in a browser. The program also listens on 5001 to serve tiles; it still works if the firewall does not let that one through.
en.notes.2: There is no installer, and no auto-update. No MSI / DMG / DEB is produced; switching version means downloading a new package.
en.notes.3: Every package contains the 167 MB global base terrain volumes, so the size is on the large side. The release page carries a SHA-256 manifest, so you can verify that the copy you have is the original.
en.notes.4: Intel Macs are not supported — the macOS package comes in Apple Silicon (arm64) only.
en.notes.5: When moving it, move the whole terraforge/ directory together. Moving only the executable reports Corrupt bundle: missing GDAL/PROJ data directories.
en.notes.6: On macOS, before the first run, execute xattr -cr . inside the extracted directory to clear the quarantine attribute.
en.notes.7: The program listens on 0.0.0.0:5000 and has no login or authentication mechanism at all; its API can read and write local disk paths and delete directories. Use it only on a trusted local machine or LAN, and do not expose it directly to the public internet.
